# MDL306 · `leading-whitespace`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A key, comment or group header is indented.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | values |
| Default severity | info |
| Fix | safe |
| Design references | K2, cases 15, 16, 17 |

## Why

GLib ignores indentation, so it is harmless for keys and comments. An indented group header is not: mydumper's pre-processor does not reset its state after it, and an empty line below it makes the file unloadable (see MDL108 and MDL112). Keeping every line flush left avoids the trap.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
  [mydumper]
	threads=4
  # comment
```

```text
1:1-1:3 info MDL306[leading-whitespace] indented group header: mydumper's pre-processor does not reset its state after it
  fix (safe): Remove the indentation
2:1-2:2 info MDL306[leading-whitespace] indented key
  fix (safe): Remove the indentation
3:1-3:3 info MDL306[leading-whitespace] indented comment
  fix (safe): Remove the indentation
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix`:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=4
# comment
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL306: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL306` on the line above it.
